name: EHP Resort & Marina
positioning: Nine-acre waterfront resort and marina on Three Mile Harbor in East Hampton, formerly East Hampton Point, with cottages and suites in a modern Mediterranean style
best_for: Travelers arriving by yacht or wanting time on the water
Families wanting a cottage with a full kitchen
Couples wanting a suite with a rooftop deck

facts.text: EHP Resort & Marina is a nine-acre waterfront resort, marina and wedding destination inspired by a modern Mediterranean ethos.
The resort sits on the edge of Three Mile Harbor and centers around its marina.
The resort is at 295 Three Mile Harbor Hog Creek Road in East Hampton, New York.
The property was formerly East Hampton Point.
Accommodations combine modern minimalism with subtle Mediterranean touches and a calming palette.
The resort offers private cottage accommodations.
The restaurant Si Si is inspired by coastal Mediterranean dining, with flavors of Italy, Greece, Spain, Morocco and beyond.
The resort has a pool, a tennis court and plenty of outdoor space for children.
The resort can arrange babysitting services.
The concierge can book dinner reservations and arrange boat charters.
Charters can stop for a swim at a secluded beach and cruise by the local lighthouses of Long Island's East End.
The resort meets ADA standards, with accessible rooms and facilities throughout the property.

highlights.text: The Magari Harbor House suites have Carrara marble bathrooms and rooftop decks.
The marina overlooks Three Mile Harbor and lets guests traveling by yacht dock and dine.
Resort guests can design their own boat charter or choose from the captain's preferred experiences.
The one- and two-bedroom cottages have fully equipped kitchens and generous living spaces.
Rooms have Assouline travel books, Acqua di Parma bath products, Frette linens and Vitruvi diffusers.

considerations.text: The resort is on Three Mile Harbor rather than in the village; East Hampton Village, with its boutiques and restaurants, is within 15 minutes by car.
Si Si reservations can be scarce over the summer months, so booking ahead is advised.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the exclusive Hamptons location.
